name: What should I prepare before contacting a general contractor for an estimate?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a general contractor for an estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before reaching out to a contractor, clarify your project scope, prioritize your must-have features versus nice-to-have upgrades, and set a realistic overall budget. It is helpful to take basic measurements of the room and collect visual examples of preferred finish styles, such as tile patterns, cabinetry profiles, and molding details. Additionally, consider daily household routines during construction, such as identifying an alternate bathroom or temporary meal prep area, and note any existing home issues like water damage or settling walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Define your project scope, establish a target budget, gather visual inspiration, measure basic room dimensions, and identify any structural or water-damage concerns.
